experiment: Third-round CSI300 research: nonlinear and official pretrained baselines, then cross-index information
classification: Exploratory development walk-forward on previously inspected historical outcomes. No virgin holdout and no live trading.
frozen_data: Reuse unchanged research/data Tencent snapshots through 2026-08-31. No new prices, no amount fabrication.
label: Actual open after next observed same-weekday anchor / open after current anchor - 1, identical to round 2.
quality: Reuse round-2 target input/completed-label validity masks. Cross-index features require 125 observed same-calendar valid OHLCV rows for all seven other indices. Target-only primary arms keep full available history. Two additional target-only matched-history controls and both cross-index arms use the identical panel-valid training intersection. All six arms evaluate identical anchors.
validation: 2018-2020 Friday anchors, all validation label endpoints <= 2020-12-31. Quarterly expanding refits, all daily training labels completed by the previous quarter end.
development: Exact 272 round-1 weekly anchors in 2021-2026, provided all cross-index input windows are valid; assert complete coverage.
cadence: Quarterly expanding training for every locally trained arm; inherited round-2 choice, not an independently proven improvement.

per_index_per_length: sum log returns relative to CSI300
return std minus CSI300 return std
correlation of daily log returns with CSI300
market_per_length: fraction of seven indices with positive cumulative return
cross-index std of cumulative log returns
cross_index_features.alignment: Exact historical trading dates only, no backfill/forward fill or fitting on future data. First return in each 125-bar window is zero, matching round 2. Indices are correlated explanatory channels, not independent samples.

ridge_objective: mean squared loss + lambda * squared coefficient norm; fit scaler on training rows only.
selection: Choose full-history target-only ridge lambda and HGB configuration by lowest pooled validation execution-return RMSE, ties favor stronger ridge/smaller HGB. Copy exact selected parameters to matched-history target-only and cross-index counterparts without retuning. Report matched-history and cross-index validation diagnostics. Freeze selections before any development prediction scoring. No test-selected threshold, seed, or model winner.

kronos.cutoff_evidence: Paper Appendix Task Implementation Details; public model cards do not independently disclose checkpoint-specific training dates. HF histories show model uploads on 2025-06-30 and later README-only changes; verify weight LFS hashes against initial model-upload revisions.
kronos.release_caveat: Conservative post-paper/finetune announcement slice; does not claim availability of the current April-2026 source revision at historical dates.
kronos.mode: Official frozen tokenizer and model in eval mode, no fine-tuning or output calibration.
kronos.inputs: 125 raw OHLCV daily bars; explicitly set absent amount channel to zero to prevent official predictor synthesizing price*volume. Separate OHLC-only diagnostic explicitly sets both volume and amount to zero.
kronos.forecast_horizon: Generate from anchor+1 through actual scheduled exit open, using future trading-calendar timestamps only. No future market values passed. Usually six trading bars, longer if an actual Friday is skipped for holidays.
kronos.return_mapping: Predicted exit open / predicted entry open - 1. Both denominator and numerator are generated before entry; never use actual next open in forecast.
kronos.seed_rule: For each anchor and seed use manual_seed(base_seed + anchor). Average the three official 8-path mean OHLCVA forecasts first, then form the open-to-open return. Save and score every seed diagnostically; never select a seed.
kronos.device: Existing CPU PyTorch runtime, float32, four intra-op threads. No driver or shared environment modifications.
kronos.invalid_outputs: Save OHLC-constraint violation rate. Fail if any non-finite output or non-positive predicted entry/exit open; do not selectively skip/relabel predictions. No OHLC projection.

execution: Signal after Friday close, persistent long/cash at next open, zero cash interest, close at 2026-08-31 open. Restart flat for each evaluation subperiod. Unlevered CSI300 price-index proxy, not an ETF return or actual transaction model.
decision: Long iff forecast execution return > 0; no threshold sweep.
inference: Paired circular block bootstrap for return MSE, direction accuracy and mean net weekly return. Holm MSE adjustment across five comparisons in common post-pretrain window, separately across three local-model comparisons in full development. Yearly, fixed seed and largest-week influence diagnostics; descriptive results cannot establish virgin-holdout effectiveness.
scope: Complete baseline model comparison and fixed-model cross-index feature ablation. Crossformer and adaptive segmentation with neural models remain a later conditional stage, not implemented in this round.
